invariant_bindings.invariant_text: Every outbound call MUST use min(local_timeout, TimeoutBudget.remaining_ms()) and NEVER the local timeout alone.
The deadline MUST be measured on a monotonic clock and SHALL NOT move backward on wall-clock jumps.
A call issued when remaining_ms is not positive SHALL be refused before any socket I/O begins.
The budget CANNOT be extended inside the request scope; a derived child budget MUST NEVER exceed the parent's deadline. FORBIDDEN to renew without a new request boundary.
The budget SHALL be propagated across task boundaries via the CURRENT_BUDGET context variable and NEVER via thread-local state.
